attempts.exact_failed_step: Run exact bound Nemotron 3.5 comparator in clay-direct-dev
attempts.root_cause: datasets Audio feature encoding required the Python soundfile package, but the comparator venv did not contain it

FLEURS fixture bytes materialized as WAV format tag 3 (IEEE float), while validate_wav and gate_wav use Python stdlib wave, which only accepts PCM-style formats required by the downstream WebRTC VAD contract

causal_chain: The first run reached the exact comparator but failed during FLEURS fixture preparation before any Nemotron transcription.
The soundfile dependency repair was a validity repair, not a semantic model change.
The second run reached fixture validation and exposed the next deterministic incompatibility: float WAV input versus stdlib-wave/PCM16 gate assumptions.
Neither run exercised the Nemotron transcription condition matrix, so neither supports a Nemotron quality or runtime-product conclusion.

existing_source_observation.prepare_fixtures_behavior: writes Hugging Face audio bytes directly to .wav and immediately calls validate_wav
existing_source_observation.validate_wav_behavior: uses wave.open and requires mono/16kHz/2-byte samples
existing_source_observation.gate_wav_behavior: uses wave.open and feeds 16-bit PCM frames to webrtcvad

required_repair.smallest_semantic_delta: Canonicalize each selected FLEURS speech fixture to mono 16 kHz PCM16 WAV before validate_wav/gate_wav while retaining exact source-audio identity and adding canonicalized-fixture identity.
identity_requirements: preserve hash of original retrieved audio bytes
record hash of canonical PCM16 WAV bytes
do not change right-context operating points
do not claim runtime credit until the exact comparator reaches and completes the transcription condition matrix
required_repair.preferred_implementation: Decode with the already pinned soundfile==0.13.1 and write subtype PCM_16 at 16000 Hz mono, fail closed if the decoded source is not 16 kHz mono unless an explicitly admitted deterministic resample/downmix rule is added.
required_repair.regression: A fixture-level test must prove that a format-tag-3/float WAV input is canonicalized into wave-readable mono 16 kHz sample-width-2 PCM before WebRTC VAD and Nemotron invocation.

redispatch_policy: Exactly one successor dispatch is justified only after the fixture canonicalization repair is source-bound and regression-tested. Do not redispatch unchanged source.
receipt_contract_note: The previously recorded controller-receipt-envelope mismatch remains a separate acceptance concern. Even a successful successor runtime receipt must still be reconciled to the current F2 fail-closed validator contract without rewriting measured values.
scope_fence: This finding promotes only failure understanding. Runtime, German ASR quality, physical-device, GWT/J-Space, effect, training and whole-product credits remain zero for T7-ASR-008.
